title: Bound the health-cancellation fixture's satellite-listener drain and release gates on failure
outcome: A stalled or failed old satellite-listener drain in the health-cancellation fixture reports a bounded diagnostic and releases all probe/cleanup gates.
acceptance: A phase-controlled stalled or failed old-listener drain is bounded by the real fixture guard even while Tokio time is frozen.
On drain failure the held health reply and old-child cleanup are released and owned tasks are drained, without weakening the cancellation/reap/successor assertions or changing production timeouts.
